app.name: HealthSetu
app.subtitle: Rural Healthcare Screening & Teleconsultation
app.offline_mode_banner: You are currently offline. Local triage, safety rules, and cached facilities remain operational.

onboarding.consent_desc: HealthSetu stores screening results locally on your phone and securely syncs them when connected. Anonymous public health signals help your local Primary Health Centre (PHC) detect disease trends early.
onboarding.consent_storage: I agree to store my health check responses securely.
onboarding.consent_analytics: I agree to contribute anonymised health signals to help my community.

home.welcome_sub: Rural healthcare screening, nearby clinic locator, and doctor consultation.
home.action_screening_sub: Answer simple questions by voice, touch or text
home.action_facilities_sub: Find nearest PHC, Sub-centre or Hospital
home.action_consult_sub: Connect with qualified doctors via audio, video, or chat
home.action_reports_sub: View past prescriptions and health assessments

offline_page.title: You are Offline
offline_page.desc: No internet connection detected. HealthSetu is designed to work offline.
offline_page.can_do_1: Complete symptom screening with deterministic emergency rules
offline_page.can_do_2: Browse cached nearby healthcare facilities with approximate distances
offline_page.can_do_3: View saved offline reports and consultation drafts
offline_page.cannot_do: Live doctor queues and video calls will resume automatically when connected.
